messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: ALERT 03:02 UTC — High error rate on billing/usage-metric-service. Metric delta shows ~30% undercount for 'tokens_consumed' across multiple tenants. Trigger: billing-metering-anomaly-rule

Raj Patel: I'm on it. Paging @SRE Oncall and @Marco Li for billing pipeline. Any immediate customer impact known?

SRE Oncall: I see the alert. Dashboard shows a spike in ingestion latency and a backlog in the meter-collector queue. Likely root upstream. Marking incident P2 for now.

Marco Li: joining. Do we have a quick way to surface which tenants are affected?

Elena Gomez: I can run a reconciliation query that'll diff recorded usage vs raw logs for the last 6 hours. Running now. SQL: ```SELECT tenant_id, sum(raw_tokens) as raw, sum(recorded_tokens) as recorded, (raw-recorded) as delta FROM meter_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY delta DESC LIMIT 50;```

Lena Ortiz: Support looking at tickets. We already have one enterprise customer asking why their dashboard shows lower usage and invoice preview is smaller. They haven't been charged yet, but they're worried. Drafting a short customer note.

Raj Patel: Quick mitigation: can we flip the fallback to compute usage from raw logs for the last 1 hour and backfill? That may create a reconciliation burden but reduces customer-facing discrepancy.

Marco Li: We can enable the 'raw-log-fallback' path in the meter-collector config for affected tenants. Command to toggle (use with care):
```bash
# toggle raw fallback for tenant namespace
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  https://control-plane.internal/api/tenants/tenants-affected/actions/enable_raw_fallback
  -d '{"window_hours":1}'
```

SRE Oncall: Before toggling, let's snapshot current counts and create an audit record. Raj, can you create an incident artifact in S3?

Raj Patel: Created with key s3://redwood-incidents/1758504123-metering-snapshot.json and uploaded the collector logs for the last 2 hours.

OpsBot: NOTE: Incident assigned to incident lead @Raj Patel. On-call handoff scheduled at 03:30 UTC to @Marco Li.

Marco Li: Flip enabled for top 10 tenants with largest delta. Rolling this now. Pushing change via infra job.

(2 minutes later)
Marco Li: Change applied to staging and canary; metrics show ingestion backlog decreasing. I'll roll to prod incrementally.

Elena Gomez: Reconciliation query results (top affected tenants):
```
tenant-88, raw=1,240,000, recorded=885,000, delta=355,000
tenant-19, raw=980,000, recorded=740,000, delta=240,000
tenant-502, raw=120,000, recorded=84,000, delta=36,000
```

Lena Ortiz: Draft customer message for impacted customers (please review):
```
Hi —
We detected an issue causing usage in the dashboard to appear lower than actual for a subset of accounts between 03:00–04:00 UTC. We have enabled a fallback and started backfilling records. No invoices have been finalized yet. We will send an updated invoice and reconciliation summary by EOD.
Apologies for the inconvenience,
Redwood Support
```

Raj Patel: Please add a note that there's no data exfiltration and KMS keys not impacted. Also include a link to status page once live.

Marco Li: Mitigation complete: ingestion backlog drained to normal levels. We're now running the backfill job to reconcile the last 4 hours. Backfill job id: backfill-1758504123-01. Estimated finish ~45m.

OpsBot: STATUS UPDATE posted to internal status page channel. Public status page draft below for approval.

Elena Gomez: Public status page draft (please sign-off):
```
Summary: We identified an issue causing under-reporting of usage metrics affecting some customers' dashboard and invoice previews. We have enabled a fallback path and are backfilling missing usage. No invoices were finalized during the affected window.
Impact: Dashboard usage values may be lower than actual for affected customers between 03:00–04:00 UTC. Some invoice previews may not reflect true usage.
Mitigation: Fallback enabled and backfill in progress. Estimated reconciliation completion within 60 minutes.
Next update: In 30 minutes or when backfill completes.
```

Lena Ortiz: Approved. I'll publish and send the customer note to affected accounts. Adding recommended support responses for the CS team.

Support Bot: Automated note queued: customer_emails/1758504123-metering-discrepancy-draft — scheduled send in 10m after manual verification.

SRE Oncall: We should also add an internal post-incident action item: investigate why the meter-collector queue didn't autoscale. Logging: ticket INFRA-1226.

Raj Patel: Created INFRA-1226 and assigned to eng-infra. Also creating a follow-up on rollback thresholds for the raw-fallback toggle.

Marco Li: Backfill progress: 30% complete. No signs of duplicated billing so far. We'll run a dedupe pass after completion using event_id windowing. SQL snippet for dedupe check:
```sql
SELECT event_id, count(*) FROM backfilled_events WHERE ts >= '2025-11-21T03:00:00Z' GROUP BY event_id HAVING count(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;
```

Elena Gomez: Backfill finished. Jobs report reconciled tokens ~= 1.02x of recorded (expected delta resolved). Exported reconciliation CSV to s3://redwood-incidents/1758504123-reconciliation.csv

OpsBot: FINAL UPDATE — Mitigation complete, backfill finished, customer notifications sent. Incident severity downgraded to SEV-VERIFIED.

Lena Ortiz: Customer responses so far: a handful acknowledged and appreciated the proactive note. One asked for a line item reconciliation for their finance team — sending that now.

Raj Patel: We'll schedule a brevity postmortem tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Action items: 1) fix autoscaling for meter-collector queue (INFRA-1226), 2) add canary checks on ingestion-to-recorded ratio, 3) improve dashboards to flag large delta sooner.

Marco Li: Thanks all. Great coordination.

SRE Oncall: Handing off run to next on-call @Marco Li at 03:30 UTC (per OpsBot). Logging handoff in incident timeline.

OpsBot: Incident thread closed for active mitigation but will remain for postmortem notes.
